$ANDE Q3 2026: Revenue $2.8B, up 6% Y/Y, driven by strong performance in the Renewables segment and clean fuel production credits. Net earnings totaled $46M as Agribusiness merchandising improved. #earnings #industrials
$CWK Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $2.8B, +8% Y/Y, driven by growth in leasing and capital markets. Operating margin was 4.6% as services and project management expanded. #earnings #realestate
